name: Bournemouth Beach Lodges
accommodation: Self-contained lodges sleeping up to four adults and two children
suitableFor: Families and small groups wanting to stay right on the beach
beachAccess: A few steps from the sand on the promenade near Boscombe Pier
confirmedFeatures: Kitchen, shower room, Wi-Fi, sea-view terrace with deckchairs, open all year
overview: Modern lodges built into the cliffside on the promenade near Boscombe Pier, a few steps from the sand. Each has a kitchen, shower room, Wi-Fi and a terrace with sea views, and they sleep up to four adults and two children, with stays available all year.
surfTripFit: You are steps from the Boscombe Pier peaks, so you can check the waves from the terrace and be in the water within minutes.
